column3: (Cacheability notes: informational. API responses default to no-store; /assets is immutable by design)
(Modern Web Application: informational, the viewer is a single-page app)
(CSP notes: img-src https: is needed for sign-in provider avatars; style-src unsafe-inline for UI library style tags)
(Cross-Origin headers: CORP and COOP are set; COEP is left out on purpose because require-corp blocks avatars)
(Private IP disclosure: the 10.8.0.0/24 example text in the network access settings)
(Client error responses: 401/404 from an unauthenticated API scan are the expected result)
(Unexpected Content-Type: non-API paths fall back to the viewer HTML by design)
